basic_info.name: Allcargo Logistics
basic_info.description: Allcargo Logistics is one of India’s premier Express Logistics and Supply Chain Management companies, committed to delighting customers with seamless, end-to-end logistics solutions backed by future-ready digital tools and technology.With a legacy of over three decades, we bring deep expertise across surface and air express, consultative logistics, providing integrated logistics solutions for retail, MSME, and enterprise customers. Backed by a truly national reach, we serve 100% of India’s PIN codes, enabling businesses to grow with speed, confidence, and reliability.As part of the Allcargo Group, we are uniquely positioned to offer integrated capabilities across International Supply Chain, CFS-ICD operations, Logistics Parks, and more—ensuring a comprehensive, connected logistics ecosystem.Driven by a digital-first approach, we leverage advanced systems including enterprise-wide ERP platforms, digital payment solutions, and the Genie WhatsApp chatbot to deliver swift, safe, and on-time services—every single time.Guided by our core value of caring for the environment and society, we uphold global ESG benchmarks and remain committed to building a sustainable, future-ready logistics landscape.
industries: Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage
